tara: quick tie-off from the PM: we still have 3 action items that need explicit owners, backups, and recurrence notes before I close the loop. can we lock today?

leo: list them pls

tara: A) prefetch/cache thrash under mixed batch sizes (recurs across dedicated/private) B) rollback gating + rehearsal (we need a dry-run with toggle) C) remediation board hygiene: tag recurrence + add short timeline entries to tickets.

dina: I can own A (cache thrash). will run traces and attach heap/KV timelines. filing INF-4322. ETA investigation + repro by 2026-04-05.

triage-bot: Created INF-4322 (Prefetch/cache thrash) and assigned to dina.

jon: I'll take B (rollback gating + rehearsal). need runtime QA pairing. opening INF-4323. ETA dry-run + checklist 2026-04-07.

triage-bot: Created INF-4323 (Rollback gating + dry-run) and assigned to jon.

tara: I'll take C (board hygiene). will sweep tickets, add recurrence tag and short timelines. filing INF-4324. ETA 2026-04-03.

triage-bot: Created INF-4324 (Remediation board hygiene) and assigned to tara.

dina: proposed RACI quick: A R=dina A=tara C=eng-runtime/eng-sre I=oncall; B R=jon A=tara C=qa/runtime I=customers; C R=tara A=program-lead C=triage-team I=stakeholders.

jon: backups? if I'm oncall/OOO who covers rollback?

dina: backup for A = leo.

leo: backup for B = dina.

tara: backup for C = jon.

leo: recurrence note: cache thrash seen 3x in last 9 weeks under mixed short/long sequence workloads. will add short reproducer and load-profile to INF-4322.

dina: attaching flamegraphs + sample keysets to INF-4322 now.

jon: will attach `rollback-playbook.md` and rehearsal checklist to INF-4323 and request a 90-min QA slot.

tara: please set JIRA fields: remediation owner, backup, remediation ETA, and link PRs to the PM doc. i'll run a quick 10-min sync Thu 09:30 to confirm.

dina: INF-4322 ETA 2026-04-05. PR link will follow.

jon: INF-4323 ETA 2026-04-07. QA slot requested.

tara: INF-4324 ETA 2026-04-03. board sweep scheduled.

leo: noted. leaving thread open until all three move to In Progress on remediation board. i'll escalate to platform leads if any cross-team blockers surface by Fri. :white_check_mark:
